storage_estimate.note: Upper bound counts regular copies separately; transient per-file verified staging may temporarily require another asset/object size. No hard links or symlinks are materialized.

path_map.semantics: Historical logical_path -> restore-root relative objects/<sha>; appended keys only, no changed existing mapping.

scope: Size/SHA of selected downloaded or reused assets, ordered joined stream SHA, and selected content bytes. Remote-readback coverage is only remote_assets_read; cached local bytes and unpublished/unselected assets are not claimed remotely re-read.
